typography.usage_rules: Never use Inter for headings. Use JetBrains Mono for all IP addresses, Ports, Domains, and raw technical data. Use Outfit for prominent marketing/dashboard headings.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton with border-collapse layouts and 1px borders on the right and bottom of grid items. Use sharp edges (max 4px border-radius) or completely square corners.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for sticky headers/floating navs: bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-b border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.effects: Subtle drop shadows on critical metrics. Use neon glow (box-shadow or radial-gradient) sparingly for 'Vulnerable' or 'Critical' alerts to make them pop against the dark void.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate a subtle noise/grain overlay globally to reduce digital flatness and enhance the 'Tactical Pro' feel.

layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with tight gap-4. Every pixel utilized.
layouts.spacing_strategy: Generous Spacing (p-6 or p-8 inside structural containers). Never cramp data. Use tabular-nums for numerical data alignment.
layouts.sidebar: Collapsible left-sidebar or strict F-pattern layout for navigation. Includes anchor links or tabs to jump to WHOIS, DNS, SSL, etc.

components.domain_search: Massive, prominent search bar (similar to a terminal prompt or search engine). Uses neon glowing border on focus. Include a primary CTA button inline.
components.cards: Flat, 1px border, rectangular (no Shadcn default rounded Card). Use raw divs with border-white/10 and background #0C0C0E.
components.badges: Sharp edges, 10% opacity background of the status color, solid text color (e.g., bg-red-500/10 text-red-500).
components.charts: Recharts or Shadcn charts customized with primary/status colors. Avoid generic colorful palettes; stick to the tactical color scheme.
components.tabs: Use horizontal or vertical tabs to jump between report sections (WHOIS, Headers, IP, etc.) to prevent infinite scrolling fatigue.

motion.interactions: Hover states slightly lift (-translate-y-0.5) with border color change. Fast, technical transitions (0.15s ease).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for bento grid cards to simulate 'scanning' completion. Use framer-motion.
motion.loading: Simulate terminal typing or linear progress bars scanning the domain for realism.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA minimums. Text on status backgrounds must have high contrast (3:1 minimum).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='domain-search-input').

hero_background.description: Green binary matrix for login screen or landing page background overlay (use with heavy opacity reduction/blend mode).

user_avatar.description: Professional user portrait for dashboard top-right profile dropdown.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Dark Mode ONLY application. Set dark classes explicitly and assume a dark background globally (#050505).
Install and use Phosphor Icons or lucide-react for sharp, technical iconography.
Implement Google Auth layout on the Login page.
Dashboard should have a history of scanned domains (table or list) and a large top search bar.

The analysis results page MUST be organized into clear sections: WHOIS, DNS Records, SSL Certificates, Subdomains, HTTP Headers, HTTPS Headers, Associated IP, Open Ports, Security Status (basic/medium/advanced), AI-powered Risk Summary.
Create a vertical side-navigation (tabs) in the analysis page to jump to specific report sections quickly.
Implement visual risk indicators (e.g., severity badges, color-coded status circles).
Create a prominent 'Export/Copy' button near the top right of the analysis view.
The 'AI-powered Risk Summary' should be visually distinct from raw data sections (perhaps a glowing border or unique surface) to highlight AI-driven insights.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
